description: `T extends U ? X : Y` resolves to `X` when `T` is assignable to `U`, otherwise to `Y`.
`extends` in a conditional type uses the same rule as passing an argument to a parameter. It is not an equality test.
When the checked type is an unresolved type parameter, the compiler keeps the conditional type unevaluated until it is instantiated.
Reads the element type of an array or the union of element types of a tuple.
